messages:
erik.partnerships: Heads up — CloudMarket pushed a bulk SKU update that changed reserved_units from '1' to '10' for partner sku CM-DDED-8 in ap-southeast. That triggered 10x reservations against our APAC pool. :eyes:
mona.ops: Got it. I'm throttling CloudMarket allocations for ap-southeast and queuing a reconcile to expire transient duplicates. Command: redwoodctl partners throttle --partner cloudmarket --region ap-southeast --burst 2 --rate 5/s
marketplace-bot: partner-notice: CloudMarket manifest 2026-04-01T09:12Z published for sku CM-DDED-8
sasha.sales: Two customers on growth trial expect capacity by EOD. If we need to swap racks, what's lead time from SG staging? diego.logistics?
diego.logistics: We have 3 racks in SG warm. Shipping + reprovision ~7 hours. Can stretch to 4 hours with express freight but costy.
erik.partnerships: I'll message CloudMarket rep to revert and ask for root-cause. Mona, proceed with throttle then dry-run reconcile. Sasha, draft holding note with 5% credit option; keep it light.
mona.ops: Throttle applied; dry-run reconcile shows 18 stale reservations freeing ~45% of APAC-dedicated pool. Running reconcile now.
marketplace-bot: action: reconcile job queued by mona.ops; job id r-2600011223-1
mona.ops: Reconcile complete. Freed reservations and pool back within SLA thresholds. Saved audit to /logs/reconcile/2600011223.csv
erik.partnerships: CloudMarket replied: accidental CSV import; pushing rollback now. They apologized and will add server-side validation. I'll follow up for a formal post-mortem.
sasha.sales: Sending holding note to accounts with ops cc. Thanks team.
erik.partnerships: Closing: throttle remains for 2h monitoring, logistics on standby, partners to fix validation. Keeping channel updated. :white_check_mark:
